import ImbalancedChen.SmallRoughMainTerm

/-!
# Absolute small-weight error in the same physical density

The sign-sensitive attachment increases the ideal small-Euler-factor times
the rough signed density. Its increase is bounded by the small-weight error
times the absolute rough density. In particular the signed rough density
alone is not an adequate error multiplier. This finite inequality supplies
no estimate for the absolute rough density or for the manuscript's K.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators

/-- The local sign-sensitive error lies between zero and the absolute
coefficient times the common absolute small-density error. -/
theorem signAttachedValue_density_error
    {c lo hi V delta : ℝ}
    (hlo : V - delta ≤ lo) (hloV : lo ≤ V)
    (hVhi : V ≤ hi) (hhi : hi ≤ V + delta) :
    0 ≤ signAttachedValue c lo hi - c * V ∧
      signAttachedValue c lo hi - c * V ≤ |c| * delta := by
  by_cases hc : 0 ≤ c
  · rw [signAttachedValue, if_pos hc, abs_of_nonneg hc]
    constructor
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hc (sub_nonneg.mpr hVhi)]
    · nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhi hc]
  · have hc0 : c ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge hc
    rw [signAttachedValue, if_neg hc, abs_of_nonpos hc0]
    constructor
    · nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hloV hc0]
    · nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hlo hc0]

/-- Exact error expression after factoring the ideal Euler density. -/
theorem signSensitiveReciprocalTotientDensity_sub_eq
    (rough : Finset ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (lo hi V : ℝ) :
    signSensitiveReciprocalTotientDensity rough c lo hi -
        V * reciprocalTotientDensity rough c =
      ∑ d ∈ rough, (signAttachedValue (c d) lo hi - c d * V) /
        (Nat.totient d : ℝ) := by
  unfold signSensitiveReciprocalTotientDensity reciprocalTotientDensity
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d hd
  unfold signAttachedValue
  by_cases hc : 0 ≤ c d <;> simp only [hc, if_true, if_false] <;> ring

/-- The small-density error is multiplied by absolute rough mass, even
though the main term retains the rough coefficients' signs. -/
theorem signSensitiveReciprocalTotientDensity_error
    (rough : Finset ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) {lo hi V delta : ℝ}
    (hlo : V - delta ≤ lo) (hloV : lo ≤ V)
    (hVhi : V ≤ hi) (hhi : hi ≤ V + delta) :
    0 ≤ signSensitiveReciprocalTotientDensity rough c lo hi -
        V * reciprocalTotientDensity rough c ∧
      signSensitiveReciprocalTotientDensity rough c lo hi -
          V * reciprocalTotientDensity rough c ≤
        delta * reciprocalTotientDensity rough (fun d => |c d|) := by
  rw [signSensitiveReciprocalTotientDensity_sub_eq]
  constructor
  · apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro d hd
    exact div_nonneg (signAttachedValue_density_error (c := c d) hlo hloV hVhi hhi).1
      (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  · unfold reciprocalTotientDensity
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro d hd
    calc
      (signAttachedValue (c d) lo hi - c d * V) / (Nat.totient d : ℝ) ≤
          (|c d| * delta) / (Nat.totient d : ℝ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
          (signAttachedValue_density_error (c := c d) hlo hloV hVhi hhi).2
          (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      _ = delta * (|c d| / (Nat.totient d : ℝ)) := by ring

/-- Transport the finite absolute-error bound to the very same physical rho. -/
theorem physicalDensitySum_smallRoughRho_error
    {w : ℝ} {small rough : Finset ℕ}
    (hsmall : ∀ d ∈ small, SmallPrimeSupportedAt w d)
    (hrough : ∀ d ∈ rough, RoughPrimeSupportedAt w d)
    (c betaMinus betaPlus : ℕ → ℝ) {V delta : ℝ}
    (hlo : V - delta ≤ reciprocalTotientDensity small betaMinus)
    (hloV : reciprocalTotientDensity small betaMinus ≤ V)
    (hVhi : V ≤ reciprocalTotientDensity small betaPlus)
    (hhi : reciprocalTotientDensity small betaPlus ≤ V + delta) :
    0 ≤ physicalDensitySum (smallRoughModuli small rough)
          (smallRoughRho small rough c betaMinus betaPlus) -
        V * reciprocalTotientDensity rough c ∧
      physicalDensitySum (smallRoughModuli small rough)
          (smallRoughRho small rough c betaMinus betaPlus) -
          V * reciprocalTotientDensity rough c ≤
        delta * reciprocalTotientDensity rough (fun d => |c d|) := by
  rw [physicalDensitySum_smallRoughRho_eq_signSensitive hsmall hrough]
  exact signSensitiveReciprocalTotientDensity_error rough c hlo hloV hVhi hhi

end

end ImbalancedChen

import ImbalancedChen.ActualSmallRosserDensity
import ImbalancedChen.FixedRoughCoefficients

/-!
# Exact ordered prime split for presieving

The decreasing actual prime carrier below `z` is the rough carrier
`[w,z)` followed by the small carrier below `w`. Both cutoffs are literal
real endpoints, and the same target exclusions and enumeration cap occur
on both sides. The corresponding retained polynomial is identified with
its fixed reciprocal-totient density before any projection estimate.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators

/-- Splitting at a real cutoff preserves the exact decreasing scan order. -/
theorem roughPrimeUniverse_split (N cap : ℕ) (w z : ℝ) (hwz : w ≤ z) :
    roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 z =
      roughPrimeUniverse N cap w z ++ roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 w := by
  classical
  have hcross : ∀ p ∈ roughPrimeUniverse N cap w z,
      ∀ q ∈ roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 w, p > q := by
    intro p hp q hq
    have hpw := mem_roughPrimeUniverse_lower hp
    have hqw := mem_roughPrimeUniverse_upper hq
    have hqp : (q : ℝ) < p := hqw.trans_le hpw
    exact_mod_cast hqp
  have hgt : (roughPrimeUniverse N cap w z ++
      roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 w).Pairwise (· > ·) := by
    rw [List.pairwise_append]
    exact ⟨roughPrimeUniverse_pairwise_gt N cap w z,
      roughPrimeUniverse_pairwise_gt N cap 0 w, hcross⟩
  have hcarrier : (roughPrimeUniverse N cap w z ++
      roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 w).toFinset = roughPrimeFinset N cap 0 z := by
    ext p
    simp only [List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_append,
      mem_roughPrimeUniverse, mem_roughPrimeFinset]
    constructor
    · rintro (hp | hp)
      · exact ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1, hp.2.2.1, Nat.cast_nonneg _, hp.2.2.2.2⟩
      · exact ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1, hp.2.2.1, hp.2.2.2.1,
          hp.2.2.2.2.trans_le hwz⟩
    · intro hp
      by_cases hpw : (p : ℝ) < w
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1, hp.2.2.1, hp.2.2.2.1, hpw⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hp.1, hp.2.1, hp.2.2.1,
          le_of_not_gt hpw, hp.2.2.2.2⟩
  change (roughPrimeFinset N cap 0 z).sort (· ≥ ·) = _
  rw [← hcarrier]
  exact (List.toFinset_sort (r := (· ≥ ·)) hgt.nodup).mpr
    (hgt.imp fun h => h.le)

/-- The small continuation product is the same target-deleted Euler product. -/
theorem roughPrimeUniverse_small_eulerProduct (N cap : ℕ) (w : ℝ) :
    ((roughPrimeUniverse N cap 0 w).map
      (fun p : ℕ => 1 - 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1))).prod =
        actualSmallEulerProduct N cap w := by
  unfold actualSmallEulerProduct actualSmallPrimeFinset
  rw [← roughPrimeUniverse_toFinset N cap 0 w]
  exact (List.prod_toFinset (fun p : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) - 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1))
    (roughPrimeUniverse_nodup N cap 0 w)).symm

/-- Every actual prime reciprocal-totient local weight is in `[0,1]`.
This finite statement does not require evenness of the target. -/
theorem reciprocalTotientPrimeWeight_mem_Icc {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    0 ≤ (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) ∧
      (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1) ≤ 1 := by
  have hp2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp.two_le
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < (p : ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
  exact ⟨div_nonneg zero_le_one hden.le, (div_le_one hden).mpr (by linarith)⟩

/-- Multiplicativity on the squarefree support, including the unit modulus. -/
theorem primeFactors_prod_reciprocalTotient {d : ℕ} (hd : Squarefree d) :
    (∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (1 : ℝ) / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) =
      1 / (Nat.totient d : ℝ) := by
  have ht : Nat.totient d = ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, (p - 1) := by
    rw [Nat.totient_eq_div_primeFactors_mul, Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hd,
      Nat.div_self (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd.ne_zero), one_mul]
  rw [ht, Nat.cast_prod, Finset.prod_div_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.prod_const_one]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  simpa only [Nat.cast_one] using (Nat.cast_sub (R := ℝ) (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).ne_zero)).symm

/-- The actual retained polynomial has exactly the density of its fixed
modulus coefficient; no absolute values or changed support are introduced. -/
theorem oddFirstExitRetainedPolynomial_eq_fixedRoughDensity
    (retainOdd : List ℕ → Bool) (N cap : ℕ) (w z : ℝ) :
    oddFirstExitRetainedPolynomial retainOdd
        (fun p => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) (roughPrimeUniverse N cap w z) =
      reciprocalTotientDensity (fixedRoughSupport retainOdd N cap w z)
        (fixedRoughCoefficient retainOdd N cap w z) := by
  rw [oddFirstExitRetainedPolynomial_eq_leaves_sum,
    roughPrimeRetainedLeaves_sum_eq_retainedModuli_sum,
    oddFirstExitRetainedModuli_independent retainOdd
      (fun p => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) (fun _ => 1)]
  unfold reciprocalTotientDensity
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d hd
  rw [primeFactors_prod_reciprocalTotient
    (fixedRoughSupport_squarefree retainOdd N cap w z hd),
    oddFirstExitRetainedCoefficient_independent retainOdd
      (fun p => 1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) (fun _ => 1)]
  simp only [fixedRoughCoefficient, div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul]

end

end ImbalancedChen

import ImbalancedChen.FirstExitPresieveProjection

/-!
# Fixed modulus coefficients for an arbitrary first-exit policy

All topology and product-injectivity statements here retain the exact leaves
of the supplied policy. No parity of the exits is assumed. The support is
fixed using unit local weights before any arithmetic test is evaluated.
The same support and its literal Mobius coefficient reindex every local
weight evaluation of that tree, without introducing multiplicities.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen

noncomputable section

open scoped List

/-- Retained root leaves, with no restriction on the retention policy. -/
def firstExitRootLeaves {α : Type*} (retained : Bool → List α → Bool)
    (h : α → ℝ) (carrier : List α) : List (FirstExitLeaf α) :=
  firstExitRetainedLeaves retained h [] true 1 carrier

theorem firstExitRootLeaves_nodup {α : Type*} (retained : Bool → List α → Bool)
    (h : α → ℝ) (carrier : List α) (hcarrier : carrier.Nodup) :
    (firstExitRootLeaves retained h carrier).Nodup := by
  exact firstExitRetainedLeaves_nodup retained h [] carrier true 1 (by simpa using hcarrier)

theorem mem_firstExitRootLeaves_mass_eq_selected_prod
    {α : Type*} (retained : Bool → List α → Bool) (h : α → ℝ)
    (carrier : List α) (leaf : FirstExitLeaf α)
    (hleaf : leaf ∈ firstExitRootLeaves retained h carrier) :
    leaf.mass = (leaf.selected.map h).prod := by
  exact firstExitRetainedLeaves_mass_eq_selected_prod
    retained h [] carrier true 1 (by simp) leaf hleaf

theorem mem_firstExitRootLeaves_positive_eq_evenListLength
    {α : Type*} (retained : Bool → List α → Bool) (h : α → ℝ)
    (carrier : List α) (leaf : FirstExitLeaf α)
    (hleaf : leaf ∈ firstExitRootLeaves retained h carrier) :
    leaf.positive = evenListLength leaf.selected := by
  exact firstExitRetainedLeaves_positive_eq_evenListLength
    retained h [] carrier true 1 (by simp [evenListLength])
      leaf hleaf

theorem mem_firstExitRootLeaves_selected_reverse_sublist
    {α : Type*} (retained : Bool → List α → Bool) (h : α → ℝ)
    (carrier : List α) (leaf : FirstExitLeaf α)
    (hleaf : leaf ∈ firstExitRootLeaves retained h carrier) :
    leaf.selected.reverse <+ carrier := by
  simpa [firstExitRootLeaves] using
    firstExitRetainedLeaves_selected_reverse_sublist
      retained h [] carrier true 1 leaf hleaf

theorem mem_firstExitRootLeaves_selected_nodup
    {α : Type*} (retained : Bool → List α → Bool) (h : α → ℝ)
    (carrier : List α) (huniverse : carrier.Nodup)
    (leaf : FirstExitLeaf α)
    (hleaf : leaf ∈ firstExitRootLeaves retained h carrier) :
    leaf.selected.Nodup := by
  have hreverse : leaf.selected.reverse.Nodup :=
    huniverse.sublist
      (mem_firstExitRootLeaves_selected_reverse_sublist
        retained h carrier leaf hleaf)
  simpa using hreverse

theorem mem_firstExitRootLeaves_selected_prime
    (retained : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (h : ℕ → ℝ)
    (carrier : List ℕ) (hprime : ∀ p ∈ carrier, Nat.Prime p)
    (leaf : FirstExitLeaf ℕ)
    (hleaf : leaf ∈ firstExitRootLeaves retained h carrier) :
    ∀ p ∈ leaf.selected, Nat.Prime p := by
  intro p hp
  have hsub : leaf.selected.reverse <+ carrier :=
    mem_firstExitRootLeaves_selected_reverse_sublist
      retained h carrier leaf hleaf
  apply hprime p
  apply hsub.subset
  simpa using hp

theorem mem_firstExitRootLeaves_primeFactors_selectedProd
    (retained : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (h : ℕ → ℝ)
    (carrier : List ℕ) (huniverse : carrier.Nodup)
    (hprime : ∀ p ∈ carrier, Nat.Prime p)
    (leaf : FirstExitLeaf ℕ)
    (hleaf : leaf ∈ firstExitRootLeaves retained h carrier) :
    leaf.selected.prod.primeFactors = leaf.selected.toFinset := by
  have hnodup : leaf.selected.Nodup :=
    mem_firstExitRootLeaves_selected_nodup
      retained h carrier huniverse leaf hleaf
  have hprod :
      (∏ p ∈ leaf.selected.toFinset, p) = leaf.selected.prod := by
    simpa using List.prod_toFinset (fun p : ℕ => p) hnodup
  rw [← hprod]
  exact Nat.primeFactors_prod fun p hp =>
    mem_firstExitRootLeaves_selected_prime
      retained h carrier hprime leaf hleaf p (List.mem_toFinset.mp hp)

theorem mem_firstExitRootLeaves_selectedProd_squarefree
    (retained : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (h : ℕ → ℝ)
    (carrier : List ℕ) (huniverse : carrier.Nodup)
    (hprime : ∀ p ∈ carrier, Nat.Prime p)
    (leaf : FirstExitLeaf ℕ)
    (hleaf : leaf ∈ firstExitRootLeaves retained h carrier) :
    Squarefree leaf.selected.prod := by
  exact list_prod_squarefree_of_nodup_primes leaf.selected
    (mem_firstExitRootLeaves_selected_nodup
      retained h carrier huniverse leaf hleaf)
    (mem_firstExitRootLeaves_selected_prime
      retained h carrier hprime leaf hleaf)

theorem mem_firstExitRootLeaves_moebius_selectedProd
    (retained : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (h : ℕ → ℝ)
    (carrier : List ℕ) (huniverse : carrier.Nodup)
    (hprime : ∀ p ∈ carrier, Nat.Prime p)
    (leaf : FirstExitLeaf ℕ)
    (hleaf : leaf ∈ firstExitRootLeaves retained h carrier) :
    ArithmeticFunction.moebius leaf.selected.prod =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ leaf.selected.length := by
  exact moebius_list_prod_eq_negOnePow_length leaf.selected
    (mem_firstExitRootLeaves_selected_nodup
      retained h carrier huniverse leaf hleaf)
    (mem_firstExitRootLeaves_selected_prime
      retained h carrier hprime leaf hleaf)

theorem firstExitRootLeaves_selected_eq_of_prod_eq
    (retained : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (h : ℕ → ℝ)
    (carrier : List ℕ) (huniverse : carrier.Nodup)
    (hprime : ∀ p ∈ carrier, Nat.Prime p)
    (leaf₁ leaf₂ : FirstExitLeaf ℕ)
    (hleaf₁ : leaf₁ ∈ firstExitRootLeaves retained h carrier)
    (hleaf₂ : leaf₂ ∈ firstExitRootLeaves retained h carrier)
    (hprod : leaf₁.selected.prod = leaf₂.selected.prod) :
    leaf₁.selected = leaf₂.selected := by
  have hsub₁ : leaf₁.selected.reverse <+ carrier :=
    mem_firstExitRootLeaves_selected_reverse_sublist
      retained h carrier leaf₁ hleaf₁
  have hsub₂ : leaf₂.selected.reverse <+ carrier :=
    mem_firstExitRootLeaves_selected_reverse_sublist
      retained h carrier leaf₂ hleaf₂
  have hprime₁ : ∀ p ∈ leaf₁.selected.reverse, _root_.Prime p := by
    intro p hp
    exact Nat.prime_iff.mp (hprime p (hsub₁.subset hp))
  have hprime₂ : ∀ p ∈ leaf₂.selected.reverse, _root_.Prime p := by
    intro p hp
    exact Nat.prime_iff.mp (hprime p (hsub₂.subset hp))
  have hprodReverse :
      leaf₁.selected.reverse.prod = leaf₂.selected.reverse.prod := by
    simpa only [List.prod_reverse] using hprod
  have hperm : leaf₁.selected.reverse ~ leaf₂.selected.reverse :=
    perm_of_prod_eq_prod hprodReverse hprime₁ hprime₂
  have hreverseEq : leaf₁.selected.reverse = leaf₂.selected.reverse :=
    (huniverse.perm_iff_eq_of_sublist hsub₁ hsub₂).1 hperm
  exact List.reverse_injective hreverseEq

theorem firstExitRootLeaves_eq_of_selected_prod_eq
    (retained : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (h : ℕ → ℝ)
    (carrier : List ℕ) (huniverse : carrier.Nodup)
    (hprime : ∀ p ∈ carrier, Nat.Prime p)
    (leaf₁ leaf₂ : FirstExitLeaf ℕ)
    (hleaf₁ : leaf₁ ∈ firstExitRootLeaves retained h carrier)
    (hleaf₂ : leaf₂ ∈ firstExitRootLeaves retained h carrier)
    (hprod : leaf₁.selected.prod = leaf₂.selected.prod) :
    leaf₁ = leaf₂ := by
  have hselected : leaf₁.selected = leaf₂.selected :=
    firstExitRootLeaves_selected_eq_of_prod_eq
      retained h carrier huniverse hprime leaf₁ leaf₂ hleaf₁ hleaf₂ hprod
  have hpositive : leaf₁.positive = leaf₂.positive := by
    rw [mem_firstExitRootLeaves_positive_eq_evenListLength
        retained h carrier leaf₁ hleaf₁,
      mem_firstExitRootLeaves_positive_eq_evenListLength
        retained h carrier leaf₂ hleaf₂,
      hselected]
  have hmass : leaf₁.mass = leaf₂.mass := by
    rw [mem_firstExitRootLeaves_mass_eq_selected_prod
        retained h carrier leaf₁ hleaf₁,
      mem_firstExitRootLeaves_mass_eq_selected_prod
        retained h carrier leaf₂ hleaf₂,
      hselected]
  exact FirstExitLeaf.ext hselected hpositive hmass

theorem firstExitRootLeaves_selectedProd_injOn
    (retained : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (h : ℕ → ℝ)
    (carrier : List ℕ) (huniverse : carrier.Nodup)
    (hprime : ∀ p ∈ carrier, Nat.Prime p) :
    Set.InjOn (fun leaf : FirstExitLeaf ℕ => leaf.selected.prod)
      {leaf | leaf ∈ firstExitRootLeaves retained h carrier} := by
  intro leaf₁ hleaf₁ leaf₂ hleaf₂ hprod
  exact firstExitRootLeaves_eq_of_selected_prod_eq
    retained h carrier huniverse hprime leaf₁ leaf₂ hleaf₁ hleaf₂ hprod

theorem mem_firstExitRootLeaves_value_eq_signed_selected_prod
    {α : Type*} (retained : Bool → List α → Bool) (h : α → ℝ)
    (carrier : List α) (leaf : FirstExitLeaf α)
    (hleaf : leaf ∈ firstExitRootLeaves retained h carrier) :
    leaf.value = signedTreeCoefficient (evenListLength leaf.selected)
      (leaf.selected.map h).prod := by
  unfold FirstExitLeaf.value
  rw [mem_firstExitRootLeaves_positive_eq_evenListLength
      retained h carrier leaf hleaf,
    mem_firstExitRootLeaves_mass_eq_selected_prod
      retained h carrier leaf hleaf]

theorem mem_firstExitRootLeaves_value_eq_moebius_mul_selected_prod
    (retained : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (h : ℕ → ℝ)
    (carrier : List ℕ) (huniverse : carrier.Nodup)
    (hprime : ∀ p ∈ carrier, Nat.Prime p)
    (leaf : FirstExitLeaf ℕ)
    (hleaf : leaf ∈ firstExitRootLeaves retained h carrier) :
    leaf.value =
      (ArithmeticFunction.moebius leaf.selected.prod : ℝ) *
        (leaf.selected.map h).prod := by
  calc
    leaf.value = signedTreeCoefficient (evenListLength leaf.selected)
        (leaf.selected.map h).prod :=
      mem_firstExitRootLeaves_value_eq_signed_selected_prod
        retained h carrier leaf hleaf
    _ = (-1 : ℝ) ^ leaf.selected.length *
        (leaf.selected.map h).prod :=
      signedTreeCoefficient_evenListLength_eq_negOnePow
        leaf.selected (leaf.selected.map h).prod
    _ = (ArithmeticFunction.moebius leaf.selected.prod : ℝ) *
        (leaf.selected.map h).prod := by
      rw [mem_firstExitRootLeaves_moebius_selectedProd
        retained h carrier huniverse hprime leaf hleaf]
      simp only [Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one]

/-- The chosen natural support is fixed before the local weights are tested. -/
def firstExitRetainedModuli (retained : Bool → List ℕ → Bool)
    (carrier : List ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  ((firstExitRootLeaves retained (fun _ => 1) carrier).map
    fun leaf => leaf.selected.prod).toFinset

/-- The same selected products occur for any local weights. -/
theorem firstExitRetainedModuli_eq (retained : Bool → List ℕ → Bool)
    (h : ℕ → ℝ) (carrier : List ℕ) :
    firstExitRetainedModuli retained carrier =
      ((firstExitRootLeaves retained h carrier).map
        fun leaf => leaf.selected.prod).toFinset := by
  have htop := congrArg (fun xs : List (List ℕ) => (xs.map List.prod).toFinset)
    (firstExitRetainedLeaves_selected_independent retained (fun _ => 1) h
      [] carrier true 1 1)
  simpa only [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, firstExitRetainedModuli,
    firstExitRootLeaves] using htop

@[simp] theorem mem_firstExitRetainedModuli
    (retained : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (carrier : List ℕ) (d : ℕ) :
    d ∈ firstExitRetainedModuli retained carrier ↔
      ∃ leaf ∈ firstExitRootLeaves retained (fun _ => 1) carrier,
        leaf.selected.prod = d := by
  simp [firstExitRetainedModuli]

theorem firstExitRetainedModuli_squarefree
    (retained : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (carrier : List ℕ)
    (hnodup : carrier.Nodup) (hprime : ∀ p ∈ carrier, Nat.Prime p)
    {d : ℕ} (hd : d ∈ firstExitRetainedModuli retained carrier) : Squarefree d := by
  rcases (mem_firstExitRetainedModuli retained carrier d).mp hd with ⟨leaf, hleaf, rfl⟩
  exact mem_firstExitRootLeaves_selectedProd_squarefree retained (fun _ => 1)
    carrier hnodup hprime leaf hleaf

theorem firstExitRetainedModuli_primeFactors_mem
    (retained : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (carrier : List ℕ)
    (hnodup : carrier.Nodup) (hprime : ∀ p ∈ carrier, Nat.Prime p)
    {d p : ℕ} (hd : d ∈ firstExitRetainedModuli retained carrier)
    (hp : p ∈ d.primeFactors) : p ∈ carrier := by
  rcases (mem_firstExitRetainedModuli retained carrier d).mp hd with ⟨leaf, hleaf, rfl⟩
  rw [mem_firstExitRootLeaves_primeFactors_selectedProd retained (fun _ => 1)
    carrier hnodup hprime leaf hleaf] at hp
  exact (mem_firstExitRootLeaves_selected_reverse_sublist retained (fun _ => 1)
    carrier leaf hleaf).subset (by simpa using List.mem_toFinset.mp hp)

/-- Mobius on the fixed retained support, and zero outside it. -/
def firstExitRetainedCoefficient (retained : Bool → List ℕ → Bool)
    (carrier : List ℕ) (d : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  if d ∈ firstExitRetainedModuli retained carrier then ArithmeticFunction.moebius d else 0

theorem firstExitRetainedCoefficient_abs_le_one
    (retained : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (carrier : List ℕ) (d : ℕ) :
    |firstExitRetainedCoefficient retained carrier d| ≤ 1 := by
  unfold firstExitRetainedCoefficient
  split
  · exact ArithmeticFunction.abs_moebius_le_one
  · norm_num

/-- Root products are duplicate-free even for an arbitrary causal policy. -/
theorem firstExitRootLeaves_selectedProd_map_nodup
    (retained : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (h : ℕ → ℝ)
    (carrier : List ℕ) (hnodup : carrier.Nodup) (hprime : ∀ p ∈ carrier, Nat.Prime p) :
    ((firstExitRootLeaves retained h carrier).map fun leaf => leaf.selected.prod).Nodup := by
  refine (List.nodup_map_iff_inj_on (firstExitRootLeaves_nodup retained h carrier hnodup)).2 ?_
  intro leaf₁ hleaf₁ leaf₂ hleaf₂ hprod
  exact firstExitRootLeaves_eq_of_selected_prod_eq
    retained h carrier hnodup hprime leaf₁ leaf₂ hleaf₁ hleaf₂ hprod

/-- The literal tree polynomial is exactly a sum over the fixed natural
moduli. The product injection proves that no leaf multiplicity is lost. -/
theorem firstExitRetainedPolynomial_eq_retainedModuli_sum
    (retained : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (h : ℕ → ℝ)
    (carrier : List ℕ) (hnodup : carrier.Nodup) (hprime : ∀ p ∈ carrier, Nat.Prime p) :
    firstExitRetainedPolynomial retained h [] true 1 carrier =
      ∑ d ∈ firstExitRetainedModuli retained carrier,
        (firstExitRetainedCoefficient retained carrier d : ℝ) *
          d.primeFactors.prod h := by
  rw [firstExitRetainedPolynomial_eq_leaves_sum]
  let leaves := firstExitRootLeaves retained h carrier
  let weight : ℕ → ℝ := fun d =>
    (firstExitRetainedCoefficient retained carrier d : ℝ) * d.primeFactors.prod h
  have hvalues : leaves.map FirstExitLeaf.value =
      (leaves.map (fun leaf => leaf.selected.prod)).map weight := by
    rw [List.map_map]
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro leaf hleaf
    have hselected := mem_firstExitRootLeaves_selected_nodup retained h carrier
      hnodup leaf hleaf
    have hweights : leaf.selected.prod.primeFactors.prod h = (leaf.selected.map h).prod := by
      rw [mem_firstExitRootLeaves_primeFactors_selectedProd
        retained h carrier hnodup hprime leaf hleaf]
      exact List.prod_toFinset h hselected
    have hmem : leaf.selected.prod ∈ firstExitRetainedModuli retained carrier := by
      rw [firstExitRetainedModuli_eq retained h carrier]
      exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨leaf, hleaf, rfl⟩)
    change leaf.value = (firstExitRetainedCoefficient retained carrier leaf.selected.prod : ℝ) *
      leaf.selected.prod.primeFactors.prod h
    rw [firstExitRetainedCoefficient, if_pos hmem, hweights]
    exact mem_firstExitRootLeaves_value_eq_moebius_mul_selected_prod
      retained h carrier hnodup hprime leaf hleaf
  change (leaves.map FirstExitLeaf.value).sum = _
  rw [hvalues, firstExitRetainedModuli_eq retained h carrier]
  exact (List.sum_toFinset weight
    (firstExitRootLeaves_selectedProd_map_nodup retained h carrier hnodup hprime)).symm

end

import ImbalancedChen.FirstExitDepthSplice

/-!
# Exact replacement at a selected prefix's own admission test

To change the test at rank `r + 1`, stop at the common parent frontier of
rank `r`. Every possible next selected label is then enumerated, including
labels whose branches the old policy rejects. Each candidate records the
whole inherited history, the flipped sign, the multiplied mass, and the
literal unprocessed suffix.

The new and old admission indicators remain attached to their respective
continuations. Those continuations need not agree. This is a finite exact
identity, without sign, primality, ordering or analytic assumptions.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen

noncomputable section

/-- All possible next selections after skipping any number of labels.
Enumeration is independent of both old and new admission policies. -/
def firstExitNextSelectionCandidates {α : Type*} (h : α → ℝ)
    (pre : List α) (positive : Bool) (mass : ℝ) :
    List α → List (FirstExitDepthState α)
  | [] => []
  | q :: qs =>
      {selectedPrefix := q :: pre, positive := !positive,
        mass := mass * h q, remaining := qs} ::
      firstExitNextSelectionCandidates h pre positive mass qs

/-- Every candidate is one more selected label, regardless of how many
unselected labels precede it in the carrier. -/
theorem firstExitNextSelectionCandidates_selected_length
    {α : Type*} (h : α → ℝ) (pre remaining : List α)
    (positive : Bool) (mass : ℝ) (state : FirstExitDepthState α)
    (hstate : state ∈ firstExitNextSelectionCandidates h pre positive mass remaining) :
    state.selectedPrefix.length = pre.length + 1 := by
  induction remaining with
  | nil => simp [firstExitNextSelectionCandidates] at hstate
  | cons q qs ih =>
      simp only [firstExitNextSelectionCandidates, List.mem_cons] at hstate
      rcases hstate with hfirst | hlater
      · subst state
        rfl
      · exact ih hlater

/-- The existing tree polynomial is its skip-all value plus its admitted
next-selection continuations. The histories and suffixes are literal data. -/
theorem firstExitRetainedPolynomial_eq_skipAll_add_nextSelections
    {α : Type*} (retained : Bool → List α → Bool) (h : α → ℝ)
    (pre remaining : List α) (positive : Bool) (mass : ℝ) :
    firstExitRetainedPolynomial retained h pre positive mass remaining =
      signedTreeCoefficient positive mass +
        ((firstExitNextSelectionCandidates h pre positive mass remaining).map
          (fun state => if retained state.positive state.selectedPrefix = true then
            firstExitRetainedPolynomial retained h state.selectedPrefix state.positive
              state.mass state.remaining else 0)).sum := by
  induction remaining with
  | nil => simp [firstExitRetainedPolynomial, firstExitNextSelectionCandidates]
  | cons q qs ih =>
      simp only [firstExitRetainedPolynomial, firstExitNextSelectionCandidates,
        List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      rw [ih]
      ring

/-- The skip-all term cancels, but both admission indicators and both
policy-specific continuations remain visible in the exact difference. -/
theorem firstExitRetainedPolynomial_sub_eq_nextSelection_sum
    {α : Type*} (newPolicy oldPolicy : Bool → List α → Bool) (h : α → ℝ)
    (pre remaining : List α) (positive : Bool) (mass : ℝ) :
    firstExitRetainedPolynomial newPolicy h pre positive mass remaining -
      firstExitRetainedPolynomial oldPolicy h pre positive mass remaining =
        ((firstExitNextSelectionCandidates h pre positive mass remaining).map
          (fun state =>
            (if newPolicy state.positive state.selectedPrefix = true then
              firstExitRetainedPolynomial newPolicy h state.selectedPrefix state.positive
                state.mass state.remaining else 0) -
            (if oldPolicy state.positive state.selectedPrefix = true then
              firstExitRetainedPolynomial oldPolicy h state.selectedPrefix state.positive
                state.mass state.remaining else 0))).sum := by
  have hsum (states : List (FirstExitDepthState α)) :
      (states.map (fun state => if newPolicy state.positive state.selectedPrefix = true then
        firstExitRetainedPolynomial newPolicy h state.selectedPrefix state.positive
          state.mass state.remaining else 0)).sum -
      (states.map (fun state => if oldPolicy state.positive state.selectedPrefix = true then
        firstExitRetainedPolynomial oldPolicy h state.selectedPrefix state.positive
          state.mass state.remaining else 0)).sum =
      (states.map (fun state =>
        (if newPolicy state.positive state.selectedPrefix = true then
          firstExitRetainedPolynomial newPolicy h state.selectedPrefix state.positive
            state.mass state.remaining else 0) -
        (if oldPolicy state.positive state.selectedPrefix = true then
          firstExitRetainedPolynomial oldPolicy h state.selectedPrefix state.positive
            state.mass state.remaining else 0))).sum := by
    induction states with
    | nil => simp
    | cons state states ih =>
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
        rw [← ih]
        ring

/-- Both policies inherit exactly the same parent decisions through rank
`r`. Every branch ending before that rank cancels through the shared terminal
polynomial; each frontier state's skip-all term then cancels separately.
The remaining terms include every new-admitted/old-rejected candidate. -/
theorem firstExitRetainedPolynomial_depthSplice_sub_eq_nextSelection_sum
    {α : Type*} (r : ℕ) (parent newPolicy oldPolicy : Bool → List α → Bool)
    (h : α → ℝ) (pre remaining : List α) (positive : Bool) (mass : ℝ) :
    firstExitRetainedPolynomial (firstExitDepthSplicePolicy r parent newPolicy)
        h pre positive mass remaining -
      firstExitRetainedPolynomial (firstExitDepthSplicePolicy r parent oldPolicy)
        h pre positive mass remaining =
      ((firstExitDepthFrontier r parent h pre positive mass remaining).map
        (fun frontier =>
          ((firstExitNextSelectionCandidates h frontier.selectedPrefix
            frontier.positive frontier.mass frontier.remaining).map
              (fun candidate =>
                (if newPolicy candidate.positive candidate.selectedPrefix = true then
                  firstExitRetainedPolynomial newPolicy h candidate.selectedPrefix
                    candidate.positive candidate.mass candidate.remaining else 0) -
                (if oldPolicy candidate.positive candidate.selectedPrefix = true then
                  firstExitRetainedPolynomial oldPolicy h candidate.selectedPrefix
                    candidate.positive candidate.mass candidate.remaining else 0))).sum)).sum := by
  have hsum (states : List (FirstExitDepthState α)) :
      (states.map (fun state => firstExitRetainedPolynomial newPolicy h state.selectedPrefix
        state.positive state.mass state.remaining)).sum -
      (states.map (fun state => firstExitRetainedPolynomial oldPolicy h state.selectedPrefix
        state.positive state.mass state.remaining)).sum =
      (states.map (fun state => firstExitRetainedPolynomial newPolicy h state.selectedPrefix
        state.positive state.mass state.remaining -
          firstExitRetainedPolynomial oldPolicy h state.selectedPrefix
            state.positive state.mass state.remaining)).sum := by
    induction states with
    | nil => simp
    | cons state states ih =>
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
        rw [← ih]
        ring
  rw [firstExitRetainedPolynomial_depthSplice_eq_terminal_add_frontier,
    firstExitRetainedPolynomial_depthSplice_eq_terminal_add_frontier,
    add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, hsum]
  simp_rw [firstExitRetainedPolynomial_sub_eq_nextSelection_sum]

/-- Root form for changing rank `r + 1`'s own test and its later policy.
The common frontier is the parent's retained rank `r`, never the old rank
`r + 1` frontier, so restored branches cannot be lost. -/
theorem firstExitRetainedPolynomial_ownCubeSplice_root_sub_eq
    {α : Type*} (r : ℕ) (parent newPolicy oldPolicy : Bool → List α → Bool)
    (h : α → ℝ) (carrier : List α) :
    firstExitRetainedPolynomial (firstExitDepthSplicePolicy r parent newPolicy)
        h [] true 1 carrier -
      firstExitRetainedPolynomial (firstExitDepthSplicePolicy r parent oldPolicy)
        h [] true 1 carrier =
      ((firstExitDepthFrontier r parent h [] true 1 carrier).map
        (fun frontier =>
          ((firstExitNextSelectionCandidates h frontier.selectedPrefix
            frontier.positive frontier.mass frontier.remaining).map
              (fun candidate =>
                (if newPolicy candidate.positive candidate.selectedPrefix = true then
                  firstExitRetainedPolynomial newPolicy h candidate.selectedPrefix
                    candidate.positive candidate.mass candidate.remaining else 0) -
                (if oldPolicy candidate.positive candidate.selectedPrefix = true then
                  firstExitRetainedPolynomial oldPolicy h candidate.selectedPrefix
                    candidate.positive candidate.mass candidate.remaining else 0))).sum)).sum :=
  firstExitRetainedPolynomial_depthSplice_sub_eq_nextSelection_sum
    r parent newPolicy oldPolicy h [] carrier true 1

end

import ImbalancedChen.FirstExitDepthSplice
import ImbalancedChen.RoughPrimeUniverse

/-!
# Actual histories and carriers at a retained-rank frontier

The selected history, sign and unsigned mass are inherited from the literal
parent recursion. At a positive selected rank the frontier stops immediately
after its last selection. Thus, in a decreasing prime universe, the remaining
list is exactly the same target-deleted, capped universe strictly below that
last selected prime. No carrier identity or continuation formula is assumed.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen

noncomputable section

open scoped List

/-- At an attained rank the frontier contains the incoming state unchanged. -/
theorem firstExitDepthFrontier_of_rank_le_length
    {α : Type*} (k : ℕ) (parent : Bool → List α → Bool) (h : α → ℝ)
    (pre remaining : List α) (positive : Bool) (mass : ℝ)
    (hk : k ≤ pre.length) :
    firstExitDepthFrontier k parent h pre positive mass remaining =
      [{selectedPrefix := pre, positive := positive, mass := mass, remaining := remaining}] := by
  cases remaining <;> simp [firstExitDepthFrontier, hk]

/-- Skipping the remaining labels turns an actual frontier state into an
actual retained terminal leaf of the same original tree. -/
theorem firstExitDepthFrontier_toLeaf_mem
    {α : Type*} (k : ℕ) (parent : Bool → List α → Bool) (h : α → ℝ)
    (pre remaining : List α) (positive : Bool) (mass : ℝ)
    (state : FirstExitDepthState α)
    (hstate : state ∈ firstExitDepthFrontier k parent h pre positive mass remaining) :
    ({selected := state.selectedPrefix, positive := state.positive, mass := state.mass} :
      FirstExitLeaf α) ∈ firstExitRetainedLeaves parent h pre positive mass remaining := by
  induction remaining generalizing pre positive mass with
  | nil =>
      by_cases hk : k ≤ pre.length
      · simp only [firstExitDepthFrontier, if_pos hk, List.mem_singleton] at hstate
        subst state
        exact firstExitRetainedLeaves_skipAll_mem parent h pre [] positive mass
      · simp [firstExitDepthFrontier, hk] at hstate
  | cons p ps ih =>
      by_cases hk : k ≤ pre.length
      · rw [firstExitDepthFrontier_of_rank_le_length k parent h pre (p :: ps)
          positive mass hk, List.mem_singleton] at hstate
        subst state
        exact firstExitRetainedLeaves_skipAll_mem parent h pre (p :: ps) positive mass
      · by_cases hr : parent (!positive) (p :: pre) = true
        · rw [firstExitDepthFrontier, if_neg hk, if_pos hr, List.mem_append] at hstate
          rw [firstExitRetainedLeaves, if_pos hr, List.mem_append]
          rcases hstate with hskip | hselect
          · exact Or.inl (ih pre positive mass hskip)
          · exact Or.inr (ih (p :: pre) (!positive) (mass * h p) hselect)
        · rw [firstExitDepthFrontier, if_neg hk, if_neg hr, List.append_nil] at hstate
          rw [firstExitRetainedLeaves, if_neg hr, List.append_nil]
          exact ih pre positive mass hstate

/-- The remaining labels are included together with the selected history;
this retains their actual processing order, not just set containment. -/
theorem firstExitDepthFrontier_selected_remaining_sublist
    {α : Type*} (k : ℕ) (parent : Bool → List α → Bool) (h : α → ℝ)
    (pre remaining : List α) (positive : Bool) (mass : ℝ)
    (state : FirstExitDepthState α)
    (hstate : state ∈ firstExitDepthFrontier k parent h pre positive mass remaining) :
    state.selectedPrefix.reverse ++ state.remaining <+ pre.reverse ++ remaining := by
  induction remaining generalizing pre positive mass with
  | nil =>
      by_cases hk : k ≤ pre.length
      · simp only [firstExitDepthFrontier, if_pos hk, List.mem_singleton] at hstate
        subst state
        exact List.Sublist.refl _
      · simp [firstExitDepthFrontier, hk] at hstate
  | cons p ps ih =>
      by_cases hk : k ≤ pre.length
      · rw [firstExitDepthFrontier_of_rank_le_length k parent h pre (p :: ps)
          positive mass hk, List.mem_singleton] at hstate
        subst state
        exact List.Sublist.refl _
      · have hskip (hs : state ∈ firstExitDepthFrontier k parent h pre positive mass ps) :
            state.selectedPrefix.reverse ++ state.remaining <+ pre.reverse ++ p :: ps :=
          (ih pre positive mass hs).trans
            ((List.Sublist.refl _).append (List.sublist_cons_self p ps))
        by_cases hr : parent (!positive) (p :: pre) = true
        · rw [firstExitDepthFrontier, if_neg hk, if_pos hr, List.mem_append] at hstate
          rcases hstate with hs | hs
          · exact hskip hs
          · simpa [List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc] using
              ih (p :: pre) (!positive) (mass * h p) hs
        · rw [firstExitDepthFrontier, if_neg hk, if_neg hr, List.append_nil] at hstate
          exact hskip hstate

/-- A frontier reached from strictly below its rank has a last selected
label, and the unprocessed carrier is the exact suffix following that label. -/
theorem firstExitDepthFrontier_exists_last_selection
    {α : Type*} (k : ℕ) (parent : Bool → List α → Bool) (h : α → ℝ)
    (pre remaining : List α) (positive : Bool) (mass : ℝ)
    (hpre : pre.length < k) (state : FirstExitDepthState α)
    (hstate : state ∈ firstExitDepthFrontier k parent h pre positive mass remaining) :
    ∃ before q tail, remaining = before ++ q :: state.remaining ∧
      state.selectedPrefix = q :: tail := by
  induction remaining generalizing pre positive mass with
  | nil => simp [firstExitDepthFrontier, Nat.not_le_of_gt hpre] at hstate
  | cons p ps ih =>
      have hk : ¬k ≤ pre.length := Nat.not_le_of_gt hpre
      have hskip (hs : state ∈ firstExitDepthFrontier k parent h pre positive mass ps) :
          ∃ before q tail, p :: ps = before ++ q :: state.remaining ∧
            state.selectedPrefix = q :: tail := by
        obtain ⟨before, q, tail, hrem, hsel⟩ := ih pre positive mass hpre hs
        exact ⟨p :: before, q, tail, by simp [hrem], hsel⟩
      by_cases hr : parent (!positive) (p :: pre) = true
      · rw [firstExitDepthFrontier, if_neg hk, if_pos hr, List.mem_append] at hstate
        rcases hstate with hs | hs
        · exact hskip hs
        · by_cases hnext : k ≤ (p :: pre).length
          · rw [firstExitDepthFrontier_of_rank_le_length k parent h (p :: pre) ps
              (!positive) (mass * h p) hnext, List.mem_singleton] at hs
            subst state
            exact ⟨[], p, pre, rfl, rfl⟩
          · obtain ⟨before, q, tail, hrem, hsel⟩ :=
              ih (p :: pre) (!positive) (mass * h p) (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hnext) hs
            exact ⟨p :: before, q, tail, by simp [hrem], hsel⟩
      · rw [firstExitDepthFrontier, if_neg hk, if_neg hr, List.append_nil] at hstate
        exact hskip hstate

theorem mem_firstExitDepthFrontier_mass_eq_selected_prod
    {α : Type*} (k : ℕ) (parent : Bool → List α → Bool) (h : α → ℝ)
    (carrier : List α) (state : FirstExitDepthState α)
    (hstate : state ∈ firstExitDepthFrontier k parent h [] true 1 carrier) :
    state.mass = (state.selectedPrefix.map h).prod := by
  exact firstExitRetainedLeaves_mass_eq_selected_prod parent h [] carrier true 1
    (by simp) _ (firstExitDepthFrontier_toLeaf_mem k parent h [] carrier true 1 state hstate)

theorem mem_firstExitDepthFrontier_positive_eq_evenListLength
    {α : Type*} (k : ℕ) (parent : Bool → List α → Bool) (h : α → ℝ)
    (carrier : List α) (state : FirstExitDepthState α)
    (hstate : state ∈ firstExitDepthFrontier k parent h [] true 1 carrier) :
    state.positive = evenListLength state.selectedPrefix := by
  exact firstExitRetainedLeaves_positive_eq_evenListLength parent h [] carrier true 1
    rfl _ (firstExitDepthFrontier_toLeaf_mem k parent h [] carrier true 1 state hstate)

theorem mem_firstExitDepthFrontier_selected_reverse_sublist
    {α : Type*} (k : ℕ) (parent : Bool → List α → Bool) (h : α → ℝ)
    (carrier : List α) (state : FirstExitDepthState α)
    (hstate : state ∈ firstExitDepthFrontier k parent h [] true 1 carrier) :
    state.selectedPrefix.reverse <+ carrier := by
  simpa using firstExitRetainedLeaves_selected_reverse_sublist parent h [] carrier true 1
    _ (firstExitDepthFrontier_toLeaf_mem k parent h [] carrier true 1 state hstate)

/-- Every previously selected label is strictly larger than every remaining
label when the original carrier is strictly decreasing. -/
theorem mem_firstExitDepthFrontier_selected_gt_remaining
    (k : ℕ) (parent : Bool → List ℕ → Bool) (h : ℕ → ℝ)
    (carrier : List ℕ) (hcarrier : carrier.Pairwise (· > ·))
    (state : FirstExitDepthState ℕ)
    (hstate : state ∈ firstExitDepthFrontier k parent h [] true 1 carrier) :
    ∀ p ∈ state.selectedPrefix, ∀ q ∈ state.remaining, q < p := by
  have hsub : state.selectedPrefix.reverse ++ state.remaining <+ carrier := by
    simpa using firstExitDepthFrontier_selected_remaining_sublist
      k parent h [] carrier true 1 state hstate
  have hpair := List.pairwise_append.mp (hcarrier.sublist hsub)
  intro p hp q hq
  exact hpair.2.2 p (by simpa using hp) q hq

/-- In a decreasing list, the suffix immediately after a label contains
exactly all labels strictly below it, in the original order. -/
theorem decreasingList_suffix_eq_filter_lt (before after : List ℕ) (q : ℕ)
    (hcarrier : (before ++ q :: after).Pairwise (· > ·)) :
    after = (before ++ q :: after).filter (fun p => p < q) := by
  have hp := List.pairwise_append.mp hcarrier
  have hbefore : before.filter (fun p => p < q) = [] := by
    apply List.filter_eq_nil_iff.mpr
    intro p hpmem
    have hqp : q < p := hp.2.2 p hpmem q (by simp)
    simpa using (show ¬p < q by omega)
  have hafter : after.filter (fun p => p < q) = after := by
    apply List.filter_eq_self.mpr
    intro p hpmem
    exact decide_eq_true ((List.pairwise_cons.mp hp.2.1).1 p hpmem)
  simp [List.filter_append, hbefore, hafter]

/-- The last selected label and the exact smaller-label suffix are recovered
from the actual root frontier, rather than supplied as hypotheses. -/
theorem mem_firstExitDepthFrontier_remaining_eq_filter
